urdu.name: فاطمہ
urdu.long_meaning: Fatoumata (فاطمہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم فاطمہ، نبی کی بیٹی ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

faq.a: Fatoumata is associated with the Arabic form فَاطِمَة, whose core sense is fatoumata; fatima (west african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Fatoumata?
faq.a: Fatoumata is associated with Arabic. Fatoumata is the West African (Fulani) form of Arabic فَاطِمَة (Fāṭima), the name of the Prophet's daughter.
Yes — the underlying form فَاطِمَة is Arabic.
Fatoumata can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Fatoumata should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fāṭima is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Fatoumata, fatoumata. Script forms are فاطمه, فاطمہ, فَاطِمَة, फ़ातुमाता.
